overall_summary: All historical videos currently have very low view counts (5 to 20 views) and zero engagement, indicating low sample size and lack of algorithmic distribution so far. Confidence is low, requiring a controlled exploration phase focusing on high-retention narrative structures.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on phone interactions like 'आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है' (20 views) and 'आधी रात को खाली चैट देखना' (15 views) performed slightly better than abstract emotional concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Continue leveraging modern smartphone isolation motifs like old chats, contact lists, and active status indicators.

weak_patterns.evidence: Broad statements like 'नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया कभी' (5 views) and self-respect angles like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (5 views) yielded minimal traction in this dataset.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract statements; ground hooks in immediate, highly specific physical or digital actions.

next_video.concept: Finding an old, forgotten voice note in an archived chat and realizing how much the voice has changed.
next_video.opening_direction: Scroll down to an archived WhatsApp chat from two years ago and notice an unplayed audio message.
next_video.twist_direction: Playing the voice note only to realize the person laughing in the audio is a complete stranger to the hardened person you've become today.
next_video.reason: Tests a sensory digital artifact (audio note) combined with a psychological twist about personal transformation.

experiment: Testing an auditory hook (voice note) instead of text/chat visual hooks to check if audio-driven retention improves initial view-to-swipe ratio.
